title: crupina vulgaris var. intermedia
intro: Crupina vulgaris var. intermedia, commonly known as "Centaurea solstitialis", is a plant species in the sunflower family. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The plant has been found to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and anti-cancer properties.
